events.text: I'll finish the RevOps OS knowledge: newsletters, an index, banned-vendor cleanup, and a reference checker. First I'm looking at what's already in `os/knowledge` and the plan.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Map revops-os knowledge layout
events.input: $ find revops-os -type d -maxdepth 4 | head -80 && echo "---FILES---" && find revops-os/os/knowledge -type f | sort && echo "---SCRIPTS---" && ls revops-os/os/scripts 2>/dev/null; ls revops-os 2>/dev/null | head -40
